about_the_game:
Introducing a new way to learn the piano!

Musical Meteors is an arcade game mixing retro aesthetics with music education. In Musical Meteors, the MIDI keyboard is your controller, encouraging you to get comfortable with the piano in a fun and exciting way.

Destroy colorful meteors and rack up score by pressing the matching keys on your MIDI keyboard. Unlock more keys for a harder challenge as you play, and earn tons of points by stringing together combo streaks! Try to unlock all the achievements to reach Musical Meteor Mastery!

IMPORTANT NOTE: Musical Meteors is designed to be played with a MIDI keyboard, but can be played with the computer keyboard if a MIDI keyboard is not connected. A MIDI keyboard can be connected or disconnected at any time. Ensure there are no other processes or applications that use a MIDI keyboard running simultaneously with Musical Meteors, as they will fight for control over the MIDI keyboard. MIDI keyboards sold separately.

  • Processor: 1.4 Ghz (Intel / AMD)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Anything will do
  • DirectX: Version 10

Recommended:

short_description: Musical Meteors is a retro arcade game where your piano is the controller. Destroy meteors by playing the piano to rack up score and level up. Unlock keys as you play, string together massive combos, and build up your musical mastery.
